exact_code_recipes.name: Euclidean Color Distance Masking
exact_code_recipes.code: function getDistance(r1: number, g1: number, b1: number, r2: number, g2: number, b2: number): number { return Math.sqrt((r1 - r2)**2 + (g1 - g2)**2 + (b1 - b2)**2); }

exact_code_recipes.name: Audio Passthrough Gain Node
exact_code_recipes.code: const ctx = new AudioContext(); const gain = ctx.createGain(); gain.gain.value = volume; source.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
